# Sold Before Sunday

UK property introduction service. We accept enquiries for properties in England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland, including rural communities and UK islands. We do not buy properties ourselves. A buyer, offer or completion date is not guaranteed.

Phone: +447780443069. Email: support@soldbeforesunday.com.
Our introductions are free to homeowners. We may receive an introduction fee from buyers, explained before an introduction. Cash offers can be below open-market value; independent legal advice and proof-of-funds checks remain necessary.
